profile_id.description: APIMatic publishing profile id (`apimatic publishing profile list`). null until the profile exists; releases refuse to run without it.

nuget_publisher.description: apimatic: the publishing profile pushes the NuGet package. sdk-repo-workflow: APIMatic publishes the source only, then bench dispatches nuget_workflow in the SDK repo with the version.

nuget_workflow.description: With nuget_publisher sdk-repo-workflow: the workflow file in the SDK repo; it must take a 'version' workflow_dispatch input.

validate_fails_on.description: errors (default): any `apimatic api validate` error fails a check or release. blocking: only blocking problems do, for a real API whose spec carries errors the generator handles.

drift_ignore.description: Globs (relative to the SDK root) left out of the generator-drift comparison.
